name: EditResource
title: Templates/Platform/Edit/EditResource
summary: The settings page of a resource: the platform shell with the resource breadcrumb, then a small Settings page heading over stacked `SettingsSection` bands in the form column, each a heading with an anchor-link button and a hint glyph over a flush `Card` of field rows. The commit band is not there at rest: on the first edit a zero-height sticky strip at the bottom of the scroll region slides up a full-bleed band with a top rule, an info glyph, the unsaved-changes label with an optional muted hint, and Discard beside Save (stacked under the label on small screens), and it leaves once Save lands or Discard restores the record. The account settings pages end with the same band. A resource with a tab bar renders it as its Settings tab; a first-level resource with no tabs renders it as its own `/<resource>/:id/settings` page. Built from `PageHeader`, `PageTabs`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, the platform shell, `Tabs`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select`, `MultiSelect`, `Switch`, `Textarea`, `Field` choice cards around `RadioButton`, `TableRoot`, `Tag`, `Tooltip`, `Alert`, `HelperText` and `Button`.

variants.name: DeployableSettings
variants.summary: A deployable resource’s Settings tab, under the environment switcher in the breadcrumb and the Deploy action in the tab bar: General, the Domains table with the environment, policy and certificate of each domain, the collapsed Advanced settings band holding Deployment Settings, Protocol settings and Mutual authentication, and the Danger zone. The bar sits under the page here, outside the tab’s own scroll region.

variants.name: PolicySettings
variants.summary: A security policy’s Settings tab, with the Documentation action in the heading: General, Modules with DDoS Protection locked on, Debug rules and Status.

variants.name: ResourceSettings
variants.summary: The settings page of a first-level resource with no tabs, drawn from the same field list as its create page: here an access list at /access-lists/:id/settings, with its name under General and the type and entries under List settings. The entries field follows the selected type, and Save checks every field before it commits.

variants.name: UnsavedChanges
variants.summary: The policy Settings tab after Debug rules was switched on: the bar is up; Discard restores the record and the bar leaves, Save holds its loading state and then leaves.

variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: While the save request is in flight: Save shows its loading state and Discard is disabled.

variants.name: DataStream
variants.summary: The settings page of a data stream at /data-stream/:id/settings: General, Source (data source and the workloads it collects from), Sampling with its rate and the warning that sampling turns off the account's other streams, Template (a preset shown read-only in a CodeBlock, or a custom data set edited as JSON in a code Textarea and checked on Save) and Destination, whose fields follow the connector (HTTP POST, Kafka, S3-compatible storage, log analytics). Save sends one test record; when the endpoint does not answer (in this demo, any host under .invalid) a danger Alert opens above Destination with Send test record, the URL turns invalid with its reason and takes the focus, and every other change stays.
